name: local-ops
description: Scoped local file and Git operations for ChatGPT through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Manage files and local Git in one folder.
interface.longDescription: Adds scoped file operations plus switch-controlled local and remote Git tools through a local MCP server.
defaultPrompt: List the files available in my local workspace.
